title: Don't Leave ANYTHING Behind a Door 🚪
old_title: In This Town Your Stuff Decides What OPENS For You
description:
In this town, a door only opens if something of yours is inside, and the little lamp above it lights up for you. People leave a sock at a friend's place so they get invited back. Breakups take forever.

My ex, Jo, and I rented a storage unit together, and I still go every Tuesday at seven to sit with the boxes. The hallway lights run on a one-minute timer. One week, somebody was standing in the open doorway of unit eleven. Every Tuesday after that, they were one door closer to mine.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment SOCK if you've ever left something at a friend's place on purpose.
